text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE to @carla_oncall and @dinesh_eng — kvcache-hosted: High kvmap growth detected on shard gpu-a3-12, memory climb -> OOM risk. Observed surge correlated with long prompts from session prefix pattern. Alert summary: 95% p99 mem increase in 3m, 27% request rate spike.
carla_oncall: ack, paging in. looking at logs now. tagging @simon_runtime for runtime-smart-routing / prefetch context.
simon_runtime: reading traces — looks like 'ghost keys' (stale prefix keys kept around due to batching replay) accumulating. continuous-batching window = 8s; many long prompts ~30k tokens causing repeated kv entries. estimate mem blowup risk ~30-40% within 10m without intervention.
carla_oncall: what's the quickest mitigation we can apply without full rollout? needs minimal restart.
simon_runtime: we can immediately disable aggressive prefetch for hosted tier and tighten batch window to 2s. small config hotpatch, no model pulls.
ops-shiftlead: +1 to hotpatch, need approval for live throttle. Customer impact comms ready? @maria_support
maria_support: listing customers with >5% error spike: cust-235, cust-901, cust-118. We'll prepare comms once we have mitigation timeline. current error rate up 6% for cust-235.
carla_oncall: simon, paste the config snippet and the curl to apply.
simon_runtime: patch (applies to runtime-config hosted/kvcache):
```
{ "kv.prefetch.enabled": false,
  "kv.continuous_batch_window_ms": 2000,
  "kv.max_session_kv": 200000
}
```
apply curl:
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/runtime/configs/hosted -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d @patch.json
```
carla_oncall: executing now.
carla_oncall: `PATCH` sent, response 202. rolling apply to 12 shards starting with gpu-a3-12.
simon_runtime: monitoring metrics -> beginning to see drop in prefix churn in the next scrape. keep an eye on p95 mem.
dinesh_eng: I'm standing by to evict stale cache keys if needed. How long do you want to monitor before forced eviction?
carla_oncall: let's watch 5 minutes, if mem doesn't fall 20% initiate targeted eviction for shard gpu-a3-12 using `kvctl evict --shard gpu-a3-12 --threshold 80%`.
ops-shiftlead: authorize eviction if needed. ops will open maintenance window.
maria_support: comms draft: "We're investigating increased errors and latency caused by large prompts; applying temporary throttles to reduce memory pressure. We'll update in 30m." sending to legal for review.
carla_oncall: 3m after patch — p95 mem down 18%, p99 down 30%, error rate stabilizing.
carla_oncall: no immediate evictions required. continuing monitoring.
simon_runtime: we'll schedule follow-up to re-enable prefetch in staged fashion after a: fix to garbage-collect ghost keys in continuous-batching replay logic. filing PR #3772 with diag and tests.
carla_oncall: note customer impact: cust-235 saw transient 500s for 15s window, now recovered. maria please escalate to account for 10m post-incident.
maria_support: escalated, adding note to upstream ticket. sending comms now. :white_check_mark:
carla_oncall: prepping handoff to @dinesh_eng for monitoring window 08:00-16:00 UTC. summary: hotpatch applied, metrics improving, PR in flight, no ongoing evictions. please watch shard gpu-a3-12 and notify if p95 mem > baseline+15%.
dinesh_eng: taking handoff. will set suppression window and check in every 30m. thx.
incident-bot: incident state -> monitoring. incident severity -> Sev2. assigned -> carla_oncall, dinesh_eng.
carla_oncall: closing slack loop here. follow-ups: PR #3772 (runtime), postmortem draft by tomorrow EOD, customer comms archived under ticket INC-2247.
